description: Find the projects (rikmot) the current user belongs to, newest first, with their creation time. Use this when the user mentions a project by name, wants to navigate to one, or just created one. Results are paginated: when hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#findUserProjectsTool

offset.description: How many results to skip, default 0.

query.description: Optional search query to filter projects by name (case-insensitive substring).

userId.description: User id to list projects for. Omit to use the authenticated caller.

name: findUserProjectsTool
